description: Avalanche and Weather Programs - Weather Station Network is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Construction and Maintenance. Locations of active electronic weather stations maintained by the Ministry of Transportation to support Avalanche and Winter Road maintenance operations. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Construction and Maintenance. Its tags are BC, MoT, PAWS, RAWS, RWIS. It offers 4 resource(s) in KML, KMZ, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-05-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
